st_navigateurs.name: Place du Défilé
st_navigateurs.alt: A harbour square on a windy day, painted in watercolour: Monsieur Verbe the mime leads a parade of ducks with his drum, promotes a hen in her nest to head chef, rides a small donkey, programs a little robot that walks a dog, escorts a line of ducklings past two swans with a white flag and baits his fishing line with bread on a bollard. The stone archway on the left leads back to the crossroads; the blue-awning street, the pier, the headland stairs and the promenade lead on.

doors.label: Ruelle des Rebonds
doors.hint: Up the little street under the blue awning

doors.label: Chemin des Vagabonds
doors.hint: Up the stairs to the headland

doors.label: Allée de la Balade
doors.hint: Along the promenade by the water

rebonds.name: Ruelle des Rebonds
rebonds.alt: A sunny harbour lane with bunting: Monsieur Verbe the mime walks along the long wall with a blue jay, crawls on a patterned rug after a red ball, points at a squirrel in the tree while his spotted dog looks too, throws a ball that bounces off the lamp post, prowls beside fish crates with a fox and sneezes as his little rocket fails to take off. The old door on the left leads back to the square; the jetty at the bottom right leads on to the quay.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back through the old door to the square

doors.label: Quai des Navigateurs
doors.hint: Down to the jetty and the quay

navigateurs.name: Quai des Navigateurs
navigateurs.alt: A windy harbour quay: Monsieur Verbe the mime pushes a giant pumpkin with all his effort, mirror in hand, guides a little sailing boat in to the jetty, navigates in a walnut-shell boat with a telescope, dashes forward with a lance at a hanging ring, a mirror at his belt, jumps with surprise as a mushroom pops out of a frying pan and watches a tower of crumble bowls collapse, mirror in hand. The stone stairs on the left lead back to the square; the headland path on the right leads on.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back up the stone stairs to the square

vagabonds.name: Chemin des Vagabonds
vagabonds.alt: A headland path through yellow gorse above the harbour: Monsieur Verbe the mime looks in his mirror as his cart of fondue pots collapses, squeezes onto a bench rubbing shoulders with two old fishermen, wears antenna feelers and worms his way between two cows, breaks a finish ribbon in a green beret beside a donkey, turns his map to line up with a compass and wanders in looping footprints. The steps on the left lead back down to the square; the iron gate on the right leads on to the promenade.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back down the steps to the square

doors.label: Allée de la Balade
doors.hint: Through the iron gate to the promenade

balade.name: Allée de la Balade
balade.alt: A breezy seaside promenade: Monsieur Verbe the mime watches a big fan swing from side to side, unrolls a red carpet for a hopping kangaroo, takes three ducks for a stroll, waving, gestures like a museum guide at a framed plaque on the little museum wall, works a small crane lifting a crate of oranges onto a cart and files papers in a cabinet with a fish tail sticking out. The stone archway on the left leads back to the square.

doors.label: Place du Défilé
doors.hint: Back through the stone archway to the square
